notes: The two wire feeds (PR Newswire, Business Wire) are extremely high volume and mostly get rejected by Scout as generic corporate PR. They earn their place only as the 'second source' corroboration the Verifier's 2-Source Rule needs. Consider dropping them if Claude API cost per weekly batch gets high.

Gaps worth filling later: Black/Latino/Asian local business journals, university alumni magazines, and regional press outside the US — none of the candidates tested had usable public feeds. A Google-Search-backed actor is the fallback (see docs/CONTENT_STRATEGY.md).
